t: Oersted - Wikipedia
s: June 13, 2025 - The oersted (/ˈɜːrstɛd/, symbol Oe) is the coherent derived unit of the auxiliary magnetic field H in the CGS-EMU and Gaussian systems of units. It is equivalent to 1 dyne per maxwell. In the Gaussian system, the unit of the H-field is the oersted and the unit of the B-field is the gauss.
